C08-M05-L03-F1.title: Enriching an alert during triage
C08-M05-L03-F1.caption: How the entities of one rule hit pass a privacy check, are looked up in five context sources and become an enriched alert with provenance.
C08-M05-L03-F1.alt: Graph, top to bottom. Alert: R2 vpn_spray_then_success leads to Extract entities (gopal, 203.0.113.66, 06:46Z), which leads to Privacy check (minimum data, internal sources first). The privacy check fans out to five sources: Asset (CMDB) with owner, function, criticality; Identity (IdP) with department, role, privilege; Network with internal or external, geo, ASN; Threat intel with ioc_match.py confidence and expiry; History with prior alerts, first seen, prevalence. All five feed Enriched alert, where each value carries its source and age.

nodes.label: Enriched alert
nodes.sub: each value with its source and age

C08-M05-L03-F1.note: Enrichment adds context alongside the evidence; it never edits the event that fired.

C08-M05-L03-F2.title: Interpreting an indicator lookup
C08-M05-L03-F2.caption: The questions an analyst asks of each ioc_match.py result before it changes a triage decision.
C08-M05-L03-F2.alt: Decision graph. Indicator lookup (ioc_match.py against minisiem events) has two outcomes. No match (sha256: the dataset holds no hashes) leads to Absence is not evidence (check telemetry coverage). A match leads to the decision Still valid on the as-of date? No leads to EXPIRED: review before acting (198.51.100.104 matches a routine VPN login), which has a dashed arrow to Validate in raw events. Yes leads to the decision Confidence, source, specificity? Low or shared leads to Weak: context only (low confidence, shared hosting), dashed to Validate in raw events. High and specific leads to Strong: raise priority (cdn-telemetry-sync.example, conf 85, ISAC-A), solid to Validate in raw events (Lesson 4).

nodes.label: No match
nodes.sub: sha256: the dataset holds no hashes

nodes.label: Still valid on the as-of date?

C08-M05-L03-F2.note: A match is evidence weighted by validity, confidence and fit; it never closes an alert or opens an incident on its own.
